image_description: A roll of white toilet paper is partially pulled out of a wall-mounted dispenser. The paper hangs down vertically, displaying a series of printed graphics: three yellow star-like shapes at the top, followed by a black silhouette of a penguin or similar bird-like figure. The background consists of a beige wall and a carpeted floor. A dark vertical frame element is visible on the left.
